description: Show which providers Spur would use to fill the requested fields of a saved property, which stored values would be reused for free, and what it would cost. Makes no paid call. Always run this and show the user the result before spur_refresh_property_data.

items.description: Data point key, e.g. physical.bedrooms or financial.estimated_equity. Call spur_list_data_providers to see keys.
